tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background: the soft box fill of the Mister Wiz class materials; also the browser theme-color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, the hero's resting state and the selected nav tab.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Lavender wells: the nav track, the 'button lights up 10 minutes before' placeholder, kbd chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Plum body text and headings on bg, surface, surface-2 and gold-soft (13.7:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, eyebrows, meta lines and nav tabs at rest, on bg, surface, surface-2 and gold-soft (5.5:1+).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The class-materials hairline: card borders, list dividers, 2px input and ghost-button borders at rest. Decorative only.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Mister Wiz purple: the default .btn fill, ghost-button text, focused input border, the brand-mark tile.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Dark purple: hover fill of .btn and hover border of ghost buttons.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary fills (8.4:1 light, 6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The join color: Entrar na aula, .btn-gold, the live hero border, the brand camera glyph and the focus ring. Reserved for the one action that enters a class.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the live hero card, behind ink, muted and live-ink text.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Brand highlight gold from the class materials: highlight cells and fills behind ink text (11.3:1 light, 9.4:1 dark). Not for buttons.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold fills (8.7:1 light, 10.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The pulsing live dot and fills that mean 'class is on now'. Never decoration.

tokens.name: live-ink
tokens.usage: Small 'Aula ao vivo agora' text on gold-soft; darker than live so it passes AA (5.2:1 light, 5.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on live fills (4.7:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Dark-purple header bars, as on the class-materials tables: table and list headers behind on-header.

tokens.name: on-header
tokens.usage: Text on header bars (11.9:1).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success message text (.msg-ok) on surface and bg. The only green allowed.

tokens.name: err-bg
tokens.usage: Background of error messages (.msg-err).

tokens.name: err-ink
tokens.usage: Error message text on err-bg (6.9:1 light, 9.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: Letters of the MISTER WIZ wordmark (white in the dark-theme file). Logo only: never for UI text.

tokens.name: logo-purple
tokens.usage: The figure's head (the dot over the I) in the wordmark. Logo only.

tokens.name: symbol-top
tokens.usage: Top of the symbol tile's vertical gradient. Icons and the BrandMark tile only.

tokens.name: symbol-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the symbol tile's vertical gradient, under the white figure.

styles.name: time-display
styles.usage: Start time of the next class in the hero; tabular numerals.

styles.name: join-label
styles.usage: Label of the 84px join button, on gold.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: h1 of the next-class and empty heroes; section headings.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The app name beside the brand mark in the header.

styles.name: placeholder
styles.usage: Muted label in the surface-2 well that stands in for the join button.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base copy: 18px is the accessibility floor.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Fica um ícone na tela, como um aplicativo.
styles.usage: Helper copy in cards and alerts; .btn-ghost labels at weight 700.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a card title, in muted. Pills use the same size at 700 without tracking.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: Uppercase line under the wordmark, in muted.

type.note: One face, Carlito (Google Fonts; metric-compatible with Calibri, the class-materials font), at 400 and 700. Headings use the same face as body, set bold.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a field's label and input; nav track padding and gap.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding; brand mark to wordmark gap; error message vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Header gaps; .btn vertical padding; .btn-ghost horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3-5
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards and heroes; input and error message horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter (phones) and the gap between sections in main.

tokens.name: space-4-5
tokens.usage: .btn horizontal padding. The header/nav/main gap is the same 18px written as a fixed px value (it does not scale with text size).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; hero horizontal padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero horizontal padding from 640px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding from 640px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

spacing.note: The code uses Tailwind's 0.25rem spacing steps; names follow those steps (space-3-5 = Tailwind 3.5). All rem, so they grow with the text-size control.

tokens.name: radius-kbd
tokens.usage: Inline key/label chips (.kbd).

tokens.name: radius-focus
tokens.usage: Rounding of the gold focus outline.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Brand-mark tile.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text inputs and messages (the class-materials instruction-box radius).

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Capsules, the class-materials banner shape: buttons, the join button, the nav track and tabs, the size button, choice buttons.

tokens.name: radius-alert
tokens.usage: The floating live alert; same as radius-card.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the hero, the live alert and guide steps (16px, as the class-materials tables).

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: The hero card; same as radius-card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and the live dot.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Hero cards and the selected nav tab.

tokens.name: shadow-alert
tokens.usage: The floating live alert only.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every control (buttons, inputs, nav tabs, size button).

tokens.name: join-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the join button and its placeholder well.

tokens.name: brand-mark
tokens.usage: Header brand-mark tile; 40px inside the live alert.

tokens.name: live-dot
tokens.usage: Diameter of the pulsing live dot.

tokens.name: page-max-phone
tokens.usage: Content column width on phones.

tokens.name: page-max-tablet
tokens.usage: Content column width from 640px.

tokens.name: page-max-desktop
tokens.usage: Content width from 960px (two columns).

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet breakpoint: wider single column.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Computer breakpoint: two columns.

tokens.name: text-size-0
tokens.usage: Default root size.

tokens.name: text-size-1
tokens.usage: html.wa-size-1, the A++ step of the size button.

tokens.name: text-size-2
tokens.usage: html.wa-size-2, the largest step. Every size is in rem so it scales.

meta.brandReference: Mister Wiz class materials (purple-and-gold capsule layout)
